name: Monthly Habit Grid

listing.title: Monthly Habit Grid - 31-Day Printable Habit Tracker
listing.description:
A printable 31-day habit tracking grid with tick boxes split across pages for comfortable recording.

Inside: a cover, a How to use page, and the Monthly Habit Grid pages covering all 31 days.

Print on A4 or US Letter paper, as often as you need, for personal use.
listing.buyer: adults who want a comprehensive 31-day habit tracking grid

instructions: Print the A4 or US Letter file at 100% scale.
Write your habits in the first column.
Tick the box for each day of the month as you complete your routine.
cover_image_idea: The Monthly Habit Grid pages printed on clean paper.
